title: #shorts Marathon Training Secret Weapon
description:
The calf muscles are often icknamed the "second heart" because of their role n circulation, but it's more of a helpful metaphor than a literal second pump.
When you walk or flex your calves, they compress deep veins in the lower legs and help push blood back toward the heart
This mechanism is known medicallv as the calf muscle pump. It works alongside one-way valves in your veins to fight gravity and reduce blood pooling.
